title: AirCore
description: Everything your server relies on, bundled into one optimized core built for performance and control!
body:
![123](https://i.imgur.com/efpCocv.png)


<center>AirCore provides a foundation for chat, economy, homes, kits, warps, and more, all built with clarity, extensibility, and performance in mind.
